party.title: Minecraft Party
party.name: Lobby name
party.paste: Paste an mp3: or mp2: invitation
party.privacy: Your IP is visible to direct peers or the relay.
party.message.idle: Create a Party or paste a private invitation.
party.message.hosting: Invite friends, then choose a game from Minecraft’s main menu.
party.message.connected: Connected. Waiting for the host to choose a game.
party.message.create_failed: Could not create lobby. Check network access.
party.message.rejected: Access rejected. Leave and ask for a new invite.
party.message.unreachable: Host unreachable. LAN/firewall may block access.
party.message.reconnecting: Connection lost. Reconnecting for up to 2 minutes…
party.message.rotated: Previous invitation revoked. Copy the new one.
party.message.already_shared: World already open to LAN. Close sharing first.
party.message.share_failed: World could not be shared. Reopen the world to retry.
party.message.sharing: World shared through the encrypted Party tunnel.
party.message.tunnel_failed: World connection failed. Open Party to retry.
party.subtitle: Play together, from the menu to the world
party.chat.title: Lobby Chat
party.message.sharing_multiplayer: Party is following you to the multiplayer server.
party.message.server_invalid: This server address cannot be shared with the Party.
party.message.chat_rate: Please wait a moment before sending another message.
party.message.chat_failed: Message could not be sent. Check your connection.
party.follow_hint: Party follows your multiplayer server. Turning this off returns followers to the lobby.
party.teleport_hint: Allows Party members to use /tp and /teleport with player names or coordinates, without other operator commands. @ selectors still require an operator. Applies only to the host’s current singleplayer world.
party.operator.grant_hint: Give operator (level 2) for this world session
party.operator.revoke_hint: Remove the operator grant given by Party
party.players.label: Players
party.message.operator_granted: Operator granted for the current world.
party.message.teleport_enabled: Party members can now use /tp without operator.
party.message.teleport_disabled: Party /tp access removed. Operators keep their normal permissions.
party.message.permissions_unavailable: Permissions are managed only in the host’s singleplayer world.
party.message.permissions_offline: The player must first join the host’s world.
party.network.hint: e4mc relay works through outbound connections. Direct IPv4 requires a public address or UPnP. LAN is for the same network.
party.message.hosting_internet: Internet invitation ready. Share it privately with friends.
party.message.internet_unavailable: Internet access unavailable. UPnP/public IPv4 may be missing or CGNAT may block it.
party.message.internet_lost: Router mapping or public address changed. Recreate Party to publish a new invite.
party.diagnostics.title: Party Connection Diagnostics
party.diagnostics.privacy: Report contains no addresses, invite codes or account IDs.
party.message.tcp_timeout: Host TCP port timed out. Check the host firewall and router.
party.message.tcp_refused: Host refused the TCP connection. Recreate Party and copy a fresh invite.
party.message.no_route: No network route to the host. Check the invitation and network.
party.message.network_error: Network access failed. Open Network diagnostics for details.
party.message.tls_timeout: TCP connected, but the Party TLS handshake timed out. Open Network diagnostics.
party.message.tls_certificate: Host certificate did not match. Ask the host for a fresh invite.
party.message.tls_clock: Host certificate time check failed. Check both system clocks.
party.message.tls_error: TCP connected, but Party TLS failed. Open Network diagnostics.
party.message.lobby_timeout: TLS connected, but the lobby did not respond. Check mod versions.
party.message.lobby_closed: The host closed the lobby connection. Copy a fresh invite.
party.message.lobby_protocol: Lobby protocol error. Use the same Party version on both clients.
party.privacy.relay: The e4mc relay sees connection addresses. Party content stays TLS encrypted. Keep invitations private.
party.message.preparing_relay: Connecting to e4mc… First use may download a verified network library.
party.message.hosting_relay: Party invitation ready through e4mc relay.
party.message.relay_broker: Cannot get an e4mc relay. Check the internet connection and try again.
party.message.relay_native: Cannot load the verified relay library. Check internet access and restart Minecraft.
party.message.relay_timeout: e4mc did not assign an address in time. Try again.
party.message.relay_unavailable: Cannot connect to the e4mc relay. Check UDP access and try again.
party.message.relay_lost: The e4mc tunnel closed. Create Party again and share a fresh invitation.
party.message.relay_tls_timeout: Relay TCP connected, but Party TLS timed out. Open Network diagnostics.
party.message.relay_tls_error: Relay TCP connected, but Party TLS failed. Open Network diagnostics.
